title: Almost-wise output list
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$. The almost-wise output list is obtained by taking the outputs of the deterministic small-bias algorithm for these parameters and applying the almost-wise transform to each output, in their original order.
caveat: The payload does not define the small-bias input, its algorithm, or its outputs, so this construction cannot be specified more explicitly.
